commitment_rule.granularity: one commitment, with its own independent salt, per committed value

derivations.yields: the encoded output committed by c_y

verification_charge.charged_to: the organisation's monthly invoice (post-paid), as its own 'VCC verification run' line
verification_charge.charged_when: once per verification run, when the submitted proof package is recorded as a round (verified or rejected). A duplicate or malformed package is refused before that and is not charged. Runs are refused once the organisation reaches its monthly post-paid spend cap.

next.with: this recipe and your private activity values
next.note: Run zero-install via npx (`npx -y -p @energyweb/vcc-prover-mcp vcc-prove --recipe recipe.json --input "<name>=<value>"`). Save this recipe to a file and pass --recipe; it carries the compiled circuit. Never echo private inputs or salts in chat. If running in a sandbox/Cowork, pass --package-dir and --salt-dir to save into your workspace. Note the returned `package_written_to` path for the next step. To view the full guide, run `npx -y -p @energyweb/vcc-prover-mcp vcc-usage`.

next.with: this recipe and the package_written_to path returned by prove
next.note: Verify locally via npx (`npx -y -p @energyweb/vcc-prover-mcp vcc-verify --recipe recipe.json --package <package_written_to>`). Do not hardcode paths; use the exact `package_written_to` path from the prove step. Do not submit a package that has not verified locally as valid. Also validate and verify that any reporting dates (period_start, period_end) follow DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format and that period_end is not before period_start.

next.with: workspace_id, formula_id, formula_version, optional period_start, optional period_end
next.note: Each verification run costs US$0.09, billed post-paid on the organisation's monthly invoice when the round is recorded. Tell the user before submitting. A run is refused with 402 if the organisation has no paid plan or has reached its monthly post-paid spend cap, and nothing is recorded. See verification_charge. Call request_proof_submission_ticket to receive a signed upload URL and single-use ticket, then stream the package JSON file directly from disk to that URL using HTTP POST (e.g. via curl). This avoids copying the ~19KB base64 proof through model messages, which corrupts multi-thousand-character repetitive zero-padding runs. submit_proof_package (alt_tool) remains available for direct inlined submission. Optional period_start and period_end (DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD) are validated and verified (valid calendar dates, period_end cannot precede period_start), recorded on the workspace snapshot, and included on the receipt.
